title: Bento Grid
content: Apply bento box layout with asymmetric, magazine-style grids. Use CSS Grid with varying column and row spans. Create visual hierarchy: one large feature card (col-span-2 row-span-2), medium cards (col-span-2 or row-span-2), and small square cards. Add consistent gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Each card: rounded corners (rounded-2xl), subtle shadows, distinct background colors or gradients. Include varied content types: stats, images, text, icons. Create visual rhythm with intentional size variation. Cards should feel like curated collections.

variants.simple: Create asymmetric grid layouts inspired by Japanese bento boxes with varied card sizes.
variants.detailed: Apply bento box layout with asymmetric, magazine-style grids. Use CSS Grid with varying column and row spans. Create visual hierarchy: one large feature card (col-span-2 row-span-2), medium cards (col-span-2 or row-span-2), and small square cards. Add consistent gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Each card: rounded corners (rounded-2xl), subtle shadows, distinct background colors or gradients. Include varied content types: stats, images, text, icons. Create visual rhythm with intentional size variation. Cards should feel like curated collections.
variants.advanced: Apply bento box layout creating asymmetric, magazine-style grids inspired by Apple feature pages. Grid setup: grid with auto-fit or explicit columns (grid-cols-4 on desktop, grid-cols-2 on tablet, grid-cols-1 on mobile). Use grid-template-areas for complex layouts or individual col-span/row-span classes. Size hierarchy: hero card (col-span-2 row-span-2), feature cards (col-span-2 row-span-1 or col-span-1 row-span-2), standard cards (col-span-1 row-span-1). Consistent gap (gap-4 md:gap-6). Card styling: rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl, subtle shadows (shadow-sm hover:shadow-md), smooth hover transitions (scale-[1.02]). Background variety: solid colors, gradients, images with overlays, or patterns - each card can be unique. Content types per card: large image with text overlay, stat number with label, icon grid, testimonial quote, feature description with illustration. Visual balance: distribute colors and content types evenly, avoid clustering similar cards. Responsive: reorganize grid at breakpoints, ensure logical reading order maintained. Animation: staggered entrance on scroll using IntersectionObserver. Accessibility: ensure grid order matches DOM order for screen readers, or use proper aria-attributes. Consider: card click actions, hover previews, expandable cards for detail views.
